> [This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.](embed:example.com-000)

The [Example Domain](embed:example.com-000) web page provides a reserved domain that can be used freely in illustrative examples, tutorials, and documentation without requiring prior permission or coordination. It also notes that it should not be used for actual operational systems. 

You can read more about it directly on the [IANA Example Domains page](https://iana.org/domains/example).

***

Would you like to explore how reserved domains are managed by [IANA](wiki:Internet_Assigned_Numbers_Authority), or is there another page you would like me to read and summarize?
